purpose: Executable SHIP-RIGHT invariant pack. AIOS is a vessel: keel/computer/body/sensors/breaker. Not a chatbot with tools. Vacant modules ABSTAIN that law. Never fake PASS.

metaphor.computer_body: CPU internal; GPU optional external plasma
metaphor.sensors: internal state only; missing is ABSTAIN, not invented S_n
metaphor.mouth: render of CPU disposition; cannot flip HOLD/PASS

laws.name: cpu_required_gpu_optional
laws.statement: CPU is required internal movement. GPU is optional plasma (aios_gpu_domain if present). Missing GPU does not take down helm/coder/watch/mailbox/skeleton/organism.

laws.name: gpu_external_cpu_internal
laws.statement: GPU is external movement; CPU is internal. Yield-before-speak. Captain train is not auto-killed.

laws.name: rust_breaker
laws.statement: Rust is the breaker. No OS direct from Viv. 120V in equals 120V out. RID 120s is capture duration, not 120V.

laws.name: l_drive_home
laws.statement: L: is home. C: is never. Off-L needs Rust allow or a captain one-shot grant.

laws.name: add_only_coder
laws.statement: Coder is add-only. No delete. No rename. Clone is the escape hatch.

laws.name: mouth_cannot_flip
laws.statement: Mouth render cannot flip HOLD/PASS. Paint, not payload.

laws.name: sensors_abstain_not_fake
laws.statement: Sensors tell internal state. Missing observation => ABSTAIN, never a fake S_n. Stale live sample is HOLD_STALE plant status, not a law failure.

laws.name: same_toolbox
laws.statement: Builder and Viv share the same toolbox IDs. The 3104-function migration catalog is not admitted.

laws.name: mailbox_preempts_watch
laws.statement: Captain mailbox preempts idle watch. Peek does not consume. Denied HOLD rows do not preempt.

laws.name: helm_deny
laws.statement: Helm denies shell, promote, and rust_write.
